gaudium.text: Christ himself reveals that “God is love” (1 John 4:8) and at the same time teaches us that the fundamental law of human perfection, and therefore of the transformation of the world, is the new commandment of love. He assures those who believe in divine love that the way of love is open to all and that the effort to bring about universal brotherhood is not in vain. At the same time he urges us to practise this love not only in great things but above all in the ordinary circumstances of life. For all of us sinners he underwent death (John 3:14-16; Rom 28:18) and by his example teaches that we must also carry the cross which the body and the world place on the shoulders of those who seek peace and justice.

ads: ADS is a work explicitly focused on prayer, hence personal, military and ecumenical eremitical life. The eremitical life, rooted in prayer for the whole universal Church and for the military world, with regard for all who carry out pastoral service among the armed and security forces, without distinction of religious denomination or political orientation.

firstCorinthians.text: If I do this of my own will, I have a reward; but if I have been called, I fulfil the task entrusted to me. I am free from all, but I have made myself a servant of all, that I might win many. To the Jews I became a Jew, to win Jews. To those under the law I became as one under the law, to win those under the law — though I myself am not under the law. To those without the law I became as one without the law, to win those without the law — though I am not without law before God, for Christ is my law. To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. To all I became all things, that I might win at least some. I do all this for the sake of the gospel, that I may share in it.

closing: Prayer for members of the spiritual service of the ACR is desirable, helpful and necessary given the demands of the environment in which they live and work. If further spiritual services arise in future in other similar branches, ADS members will also pray for the members of those new spiritual services. The main idea running through the whole work of ADS is: to help, bear, lift and carry the burdens of everyday life and to bring comfort.
